knobs.title: Active tile rounding
knobs.description: Corner radius of a tile that is on.

knobs.title: Inactive tile rounding
knobs.description: Corner radius of a tile that is off.

knobs.title: Active icon rounding
knobs.description: Corner radius of the icon background of a tile that is on.

knobs.title: Inactive icon rounding
knobs.description: Corner radius of the icon background of a tile that is off.

knobs.title: Panel rounding
knobs.description: Rounding of the quick settings panel and the footer.

knobs.title: Brightness slider shape
knobs.description: -1 is the shape chosen in the settings, 0 the stock shape, 1 circle, 2 rounded square, 3 square.

choices.-1: The shape chosen in the settings

knobs.title: Footer buttons
knobs.description: Shape of the settings and power buttons: 0 circle, 1 square, 2 rounded.

knobs.title: Blur
knobs.description: False turns off the blur behind the shade, the lock screen and the other SystemUI windows; the shade becomes an opaque surface.

knobs.title: Shade colour, top layer
knobs.description: With no blur the shade is a mix of two colours, this is the first.

knobs.title: Shade colour, bottom layer
knobs.description: The second colour of the shade without blur.

knobs.title: Shade colour, dialogs
knobs.description: The colour of the volume dialog background and similar surfaces.

knobs.title: Notification area colour
knobs.description: Base colour behind the notifications.

knobs.title: Dimmed background
knobs.description: Colour of the scrim behind the shade.

knobs.title: Notification rounding
knobs.description: Corner radius of a notification.

knobs.title: Notification rounding, inner
knobs.description: Corner radius of notifications that touch another one.

knobs.title: Notification area rounding
knobs.description: Corner radius of the area behind the notifications.

knobs.title: Notification card colour
knobs.description: Background of every notification card and of the heads-up pop-up. Cards that an app colours (a call, a music player) keep the colour of the app. Leave it out to keep the theme colour (Material You). Give it some alpha to see the shade through the cards.

knobs.title: Notification card picture
knobs.description: A picture over the background of every notification card and of the heads-up pop-up, cut to the corners of the card. Cards that an app colours do not get it. PNG, WebP, JPG or GIF up to 2560px and 3 MB; an animated GIF or WebP moves while it is shown. It covers the card (centred, cropped), so give it some alpha to let the colour through, the text stays on top of it.

knobs.title: Back arrow colour
knobs.description: Colour of the arrow that follows your finger when you swipe back from the edge. Leave it out to keep the theme colour (Material You).

knobs.title: Back arrow background colour
knobs.description: Colour of the round shape behind the back arrow. Leave it out to keep the theme colour (Material You).

knobs.title: Back arrow style
knobs.description: 0 is the stock arrow drawn with a line, 1 a filled arrow, 2 your own shape from the arrow shape.

knobs.title: Back arrow shape
knobs.description: The shape of the arrow for style 2, as SVG path data in a box where x runs from 0 (the tip) towards the screen edge, and y from -1 to 1 (up and down). The stock chevron is 'M 1,-1 L 0,0 L 1,1'; add a tail with 'M 0,0 L 2,0'. It is drawn as a line and scaled to the size of the arrow, and the same shape is mirrored for the other edge.

knobs.title: Back arrow line thickness
knobs.description: How thick the line of the back arrow is.

knobs.title: How the back swipe changes the screen
knobs.description: What you see when you swipe back from the edge, between two apps or two screens of an app that supports the back preview. stock is the shrinking card with the screen below it. off shows nothing, the screen changes as soon as you let go. fade, zoom (the old screen flies at you), flip (like a card, the new screen is its back), book (a page that turns, the new screen is under it), spin (the old screen is thrown away) and glitch (stutters, jumps and flickers into the new screen) are the others. Going back to the home screen and the previews that an app draws itself keep their own animation.

knobs.title: Length of the change
knobs.description: How long the second part takes, after you let go of the swipe, in milliseconds. 0 takes the length of the look (300 to 520). Only for the looks of the setting above, not for stock.

knobs.title: Going into a screen
knobs.description: How a screen of an app comes in when you open it, for example a sub page of Settings. stock keeps the animation of the system. off cuts at once. fade, zoom, flip (the screen turns like a card), book (a page that lands from the right edge or turns away), spin (the screen is thrown in or away) and glitch (stutters and flickers) are the others. Screens that an app animates itself, dialogs and tasks (opening an app) keep their own animation.

knobs.title: Leaving a screen
knobs.description: How a screen goes away when the app finishes it (the arrow in the top bar, the back button). It plays the same looks as the back swipe. stock keeps the animation of the system. off cuts at once. fade, zoom, flip (the screen turns like a card), book (a page that lands from the right edge or turns away), spin (the screen is thrown in or away) and glitch (stutters and flickers) are the others. The swipe from the edge has its own setting.

knobs.title: Length of going in and out
knobs.description: How long going into or out of a screen takes, in milliseconds. 0 takes the length of the look (300 to 520).

knobs.title: Picture over the change
knobs.description: A picture over both screens while the back swipe plays, centred and cropped to the display. PNG, WebP, JPG or GIF up to 2560px and 3 MB; an animated GIF or WebP moves, so a glitch, static or light leak GIF makes a new look. Give it some alpha to see the screens through it. It works with every look of the setting above except stock.

knobs.title: Strength of the picture
knobs.description: How much of the picture shows, in percent (0 to 100).

knobs.title: When the picture shows
knobs.description: 0 shows it the whole time, 1 fades it in and out so it is strongest in the middle of the change.

knobs.title: Stack reach
knobs.description: Where the cards behind the middle one pile up, in card steps.

knobs.title: Stack flat part
knobs.description: A card follows the finger one to one up to here, in card steps.

knobs.title: Stack shrink
knobs.description: Scale a card loses per card step away from the middle.

knobs.title: Smallest card
knobs.description: The smallest scale of a card in the stack.

knobs.title: Stack lift
knobs.description: How far the middle card lifts over the others, in dp.

knobs.title: Carousel turn
knobs.description: Degrees a card turns about the vertical axis per card step away from the middle (0 keeps it flat).

knobs.title: Fan tilt
knobs.description: Degrees a card tilts per card step away from the middle.

knobs.title: Card sink
knobs.description: How far a card sinks per card step, in dp.

knobs.title: Card fade
knobs.description: Opacity a card loses per card step (0 keeps all opaque).

knobs.title: Faintest card
knobs.description: The least opacity a faded card keeps.

knobs.title: Card order
knobs.description: 0: the middle card is on top, 1: cards further right are over the ones to their left.

knobs.title: Length
knobs.description: How long the gesture pill is, as a multiple of what the navigation settings chose (2 is twice as long, 0.5 half).

knobs.title: Thickness
knobs.description: How thick the gesture pill is, as a multiple of the setting (it cannot be thicker than its window, about 25dp).

knobs.title: Movement
knobs.description: How far the pill moves with the finger when you touch the bottom edge: 0 keeps it still, 1 is the default, 2 moves it twice as far (up and down it stops at 9dp, the size of its window).

knobs.title: Spring stiffness
knobs.description: How hard the spring is that brings the pill back after you let go. Higher snaps back faster.

knobs.title: Wobble
knobs.description: How much the pill wobbles on its way back: 1 settles without a wobble, 0.62 is the default, 0.2 wobbles a lot.

knobs.title: Pill picture
knobs.description: A picture in place of the pill, drawn in the size of the pill and cut to its rounded shape (see Keep the pill shape). PNG, WebP, JPG or GIF up to 2560px and 3 MB; an animated GIF or WebP moves. The colour of the pill is not drawn behind it.

knobs.title: Keep the pill shape
knobs.description: True cuts the picture to the rounded pill, false lets the picture keep its own shape inside the pill area.

knobs.title: Pill colour on dark
knobs.description: The colour of the pill when what is behind it is dark.

knobs.title: Pill colour on light
knobs.description: The colour of the pill when what is behind it is light.

knobs.title: App opening speed
knobs.description: How long an app takes to open from the launcher (and from Recents), as a multiple of the stock length: 1 is stock, 0.6 is faster, 1.5 is slower. The curves keep their shape, only the length changes. For every animation of the whole system use the animation scale options of a module's settings (global/window_animation_scale, transition_animation_scale, animator_duration_scale).

knobs.title: App closing speed
knobs.description: How fast an app closes into its icon, as a multiple of stock: 1 is stock, 2 twice as fast, 0.5 half as fast. It works on the swipe up to the home screen, the home button and the back gesture to the home screen (not on an app that closes inside itself, see Leaving a screen). It changes how hard the spring is that pulls the window to its icon; the wobble is set by the two knobs below.

knobs.title: App closing wobble, sideways
knobs.description: How much the window overshoots sideways on its way into the icon: 1 settles without overshoot, lower wobbles more (0.965 is stock).

knobs.title: App closing wobble, up and down
knobs.description: The same for the vertical movement of the window into the icon (0.95 is stock).

knobs.title: Airplane mode icon
knobs.description: Shown while airplane mode is on. A white PNG with transparency, any size: it is scaled to 17dp high and tinted by the status bar. A GIF or animated WebP moves: it is tinted like any icon (a moving silhouette) and the status bar fits it to the row.

knobs.title: Panel width
knobs.description: Width of the volume panel's background.

knobs.title: Panel rounding
knobs.description: Corner radius of the volume panel.

knobs.title: Slider length
knobs.description: The longest the volume slider gets (it is shorter on a small screen).

knobs.title: Gap between parts
knobs.description: Space between the ringer button, the slider and the buttons below it.

knobs.title: Side margin
knobs.description: How far the volume panel sits from the edge of the screen.

knobs.title: Blur behind the panel
knobs.description: Blur radius behind the volume panel.

knobs.title: Panel colour
knobs.description: Colour of the volume panel, the ringer drawer and the floating sliders. Leave it out to keep the theme colour (Material You).

knobs.title: Page colour
knobs.description: Colour behind the pages of Settings (the KamiOS look). Leave it out to keep the Material You colour.

knobs.title: Page image
knobs.description: An image behind the pages of Settings (KamiOS look), stretched to the screen; it replaces the page colour. PNG, WebP, JPG or GIF up to 2560px, a night version can be given. An animated GIF or WebP plays while the page is in front. With some alpha in it the page can be see-through, see the next knobs.

knobs.title: Main screen tile colour
knobs.description: Colour of the tiles on the main screen of Settings (the KamiOS look). Leave it out to keep the Material You colour.

knobs.title: Main screen card colour
knobs.description: Colour of the card at the top of the main screen of Settings (the KamiOS look). Leave it out to keep the Material You colour.

knobs.title: Main screen card picture
knobs.description: A picture over the card at the top of the main screen of Settings, cut to the card (centred, cropped). PNG, WebP, JPG or GIF up to 2560px; an animated GIF or WebP plays while the screen is shown. With some alpha in it the card colour shows through.

knobs.title: Brightness bar, filled part
knobs.description: Colour of the filled part of the brightness bar and its thumb. Leave it out to keep the theme colour. A gradient (KamiOS > Quick settings gradient settings) replaces it while it is on.

knobs.title: Brightness bar, empty part
knobs.description: Colour of the empty part of the brightness bar. Leave it out to keep the theme colour.

knobs.title: Volume slider, filled part
knobs.description: Colour of the filled part of the volume sliders (the panel and the volume slider in quick settings) and their thumb. Leave it out to keep the theme colour. A gradient replaces it while it is on.

knobs.title: Volume slider, empty part
knobs.description: Colour of the empty part of the volume sliders. Leave it out to keep the theme colour.

knobs.title: Slider rounding
knobs.description: Corner radius of the volume slider in the panel, in dp. -1 keeps the stock 12.

knobs.title: Slider thickness
knobs.description: How thick the volume slider in the panel is, in dp. -1 keeps the stock 40.

knobs.title: Mixer media icon
knobs.description: The media icon on the full volume mixer page (the slider opened from the panel's mixer button). A PNG with transparency, any size: it is scaled to 24dp high and the panel may tint it, so draw a simple white shape (where it is tinted, only the shape counts).

knobs.title: Ring slider vibrate icon
knobs.description: The ring volume slider while the ringer is on vibrate. A PNG with transparency, any size: it is scaled to 24dp high and the panel may tint it, so draw a simple white shape (where it is tinted, only the shape counts).

knobs.title: Media volume icon
knobs.description: The icon of the media slider in the volume panel (level high). A PNG with transparency, any size: it is scaled to 24dp high and the panel may tint it, so draw a simple white shape (where it is tinted, only the shape counts).

knobs.title: Media volume low icon
knobs.description: Media volume, level low. A PNG with transparency, any size: it is scaled to 24dp high and the panel may tint it, so draw a simple white shape (where it is tinted, only the shape counts).

knobs.title: Media muted icon
knobs.description: Media volume muted. A PNG with transparency, any size: it is scaled to 24dp high and the panel may tint it, so draw a simple white shape (where it is tinted, only the shape counts).

knobs.title: Notification volume icon
knobs.description: The notification volume slider. A PNG with transparency, any size: it is scaled to 24dp high and the panel may tint it, so draw a simple white shape (where it is tinted, only the shape counts).

knobs.title: Notifications muted icon
knobs.description: The notification volume muted. A PNG with transparency, any size: it is scaled to 24dp high and the panel may tint it, so draw a simple white shape (where it is tinted, only the shape counts).

knobs.title: Ring volume icon
knobs.description: The ring volume slider. A PNG with transparency, any size: it is scaled to 24dp high and the panel may tint it, so draw a simple white shape (where it is tinted, only the shape counts).

knobs.title: Ringer silent icon
knobs.description: The ringer is silent. A PNG with transparency, any size: it is scaled to 24dp high and the panel may tint it, so draw a simple white shape (where it is tinted, only the shape counts).

knobs.title: Alarm muted icon
knobs.description: The alarm volume muted. A PNG with transparency, any size: it is scaled to 24dp high and the panel may tint it, so draw a simple white shape (where it is tinted, only the shape counts).

knobs.title: Alarm volume icon
knobs.description: The alarm volume slider. A PNG with transparency, any size: it is scaled to 24dp high and the panel may tint it, so draw a simple white shape (where it is tinted, only the shape counts).

knobs.title: System volume icon
knobs.description: The system sounds volume slider. A PNG with transparency, any size: it is scaled to 24dp high and the panel may tint it, so draw a simple white shape (where it is tinted, only the shape counts).

knobs.title: System sounds muted icon
knobs.description: The system sounds volume muted. A PNG with transparency, any size: it is scaled to 24dp high and the panel may tint it, so draw a simple white shape (where it is tinted, only the shape counts).

knobs.title: Sound on icon
knobs.description: Sound on, in the ringer drawer. A PNG with transparency, any size: it is scaled to 24dp high and the panel may tint it, so draw a simple white shape (where it is tinted, only the shape counts).

knobs.title: Sound off icon
knobs.description: Sound off, in the ringer drawer. A PNG with transparency, any size: it is scaled to 24dp high and the panel may tint it, so draw a simple white shape (where it is tinted, only the shape counts).

knobs.title: Mixer button icon
knobs.description: The button at the bottom of the panel that opens all volumes. A PNG with transparency, any size: it is scaled to 24dp high and the panel may tint it, so draw a simple white shape (where it is tinted, only the shape counts).

knobs.title: Captions icon
knobs.description: The live caption button. A PNG with transparency, any size: it is scaled to 24dp high and the panel may tint it, so draw a simple white shape (where it is tinted, only the shape counts).

knobs.title: Vibrate button icon
knobs.description: The ringer button of the volume panel while the ringer is on vibrate (and the vibrate choice in its drawer). A PNG with transparency, any size: it is scaled to 24dp high and the panel may tint it, so draw a simple white shape (where it is tinted, only the shape counts).

knobs.title: Page see-through
knobs.description: True makes the Settings windows see-through: what is below shows where the page colour or image has alpha. Needs a colour or image with some transparency.

knobs.title: Page shows the wallpaper
knobs.description: True shows the wallpaper behind the Settings windows where the page colour or image has alpha (also see-through).

knobs.title: Blur behind the page
knobs.description: Blurs what is behind a see-through Settings window, like frosted glass. 0dp is off, 20dp to 40dp looks good.

knobs.title: Tile rounding
knobs.description: The rounding of the tiles of the main screen of Settings (the KamiOS look). 0dp makes them square.

knobs.title: Top card rounding
knobs.description: The rounding of the card at the top of the main screen of Settings.

knobs.title: Symbol round rounding
knobs.description: The rounding of the round behind the symbol in the card at the top: 24dp is a circle, 0dp a square.

knobs.title: Tile gap
knobs.description: Half the space between two tiles of the main screen of Settings.

knobs.title: Tile height
knobs.description: The least height of a square tile of the main screen of Settings.

knobs.title: Tiles per row
knobs.description: How many tiles are in a row on the main screen of Settings (the KamiOS look): 1 makes a list of wide tiles, 2 is the default, 3 a dense grid.

knobs.title: Tile that is on, picture
knobs.description: A picture behind the icon and text of every quick settings tile that is on, over its colour. PNG, WebP, JPG or GIF up to 2560px and 3 MB; an animated GIF or WebP moves while it is shown. It covers the area (centred, cropped), so give it some alpha to let the colour through.

knobs.title: Tile that is off, picture
knobs.description: A picture behind the icon and text of every quick settings tile that is off, over its colour. PNG, WebP, JPG or GIF up to 2560px and 3 MB; an animated GIF or WebP moves while it is shown. It covers the area (centred, cropped), so give it some alpha to let the colour through.

knobs.title: Tiles with a picture of their own
knobs.description: Which tile uses which of the eight picture slots below, like 'internet:1,bt:2,flashlight:3': the name of the tile, a colon and the slot number. Names: internet, bt, cell, airplane, flashlight, nfc, cast, hotspot, location, rotation, dnd, battery, saver, inversion, night and the other tiles of the list (custom tiles of apps are 'custom(package/Class)'). A tile that is not named, or whose slot has no picture, keeps the picture of all tiles.

knobs.title: Tile that is on, picture 1
knobs.description: The picture of the tiles that the map gives slot 1, while they are on. Same as the picture of all tiles that are on: PNG, WebP, JPG or GIF up to 2560px and 3 MB, an animated GIF or WebP moves.

knobs.title: Tile that is on, picture 2
knobs.description: The picture of the tiles that the map gives slot 2, while they are on. Same as the picture of all tiles that are on: PNG, WebP, JPG or GIF up to 2560px and 3 MB, an animated GIF or WebP moves.

knobs.title: Tile that is on, picture 3
knobs.description: The picture of the tiles that the map gives slot 3, while they are on. Same as the picture of all tiles that are on: PNG, WebP, JPG or GIF up to 2560px and 3 MB, an animated GIF or WebP moves.

knobs.title: Tile that is on, picture 4
knobs.description: The picture of the tiles that the map gives slot 4, while they are on. Same as the picture of all tiles that are on: PNG, WebP, JPG or GIF up to 2560px and 3 MB, an animated GIF or WebP moves.

knobs.title: Tile that is on, picture 5
knobs.description: The picture of the tiles that the map gives slot 5, while they are on. Same as the picture of all tiles that are on: PNG, WebP, JPG or GIF up to 2560px and 3 MB, an animated GIF or WebP moves.

knobs.title: Tile that is on, picture 6
knobs.description: The picture of the tiles that the map gives slot 6, while they are on. Same as the picture of all tiles that are on: PNG, WebP, JPG or GIF up to 2560px and 3 MB, an animated GIF or WebP moves.

knobs.title: Tile that is on, picture 7
knobs.description: The picture of the tiles that the map gives slot 7, while they are on. Same as the picture of all tiles that are on: PNG, WebP, JPG or GIF up to 2560px and 3 MB, an animated GIF or WebP moves.

knobs.title: Tile that is on, picture 8
knobs.description: The picture of the tiles that the map gives slot 8, while they are on. Same as the picture of all tiles that are on: PNG, WebP, JPG or GIF up to 2560px and 3 MB, an animated GIF or WebP moves.

knobs.title: Tile that is off, picture 1
knobs.description: The picture of the tiles that the map gives slot 1, while they are off.

knobs.title: Tile that is off, picture 2
knobs.description: The picture of the tiles that the map gives slot 2, while they are off.

knobs.title: Tile that is off, picture 3
knobs.description: The picture of the tiles that the map gives slot 3, while they are off.

knobs.title: Tile that is off, picture 4
knobs.description: The picture of the tiles that the map gives slot 4, while they are off.

knobs.title: Tile that is off, picture 5
knobs.description: The picture of the tiles that the map gives slot 5, while they are off.

knobs.title: Tile that is off, picture 6
knobs.description: The picture of the tiles that the map gives slot 6, while they are off.

knobs.title: Tile that is off, picture 7
knobs.description: The picture of the tiles that the map gives slot 7, while they are off.

knobs.title: Tile that is off, picture 8
knobs.description: The picture of the tiles that the map gives slot 8, while they are off.

knobs.title: Shade picture
knobs.description: A picture over the dim layer behind the whole shade (quick settings and notifications). It fades in and out with the shade like the dim layer does, so it is as strong as the dim layer is. PNG, WebP, JPG or GIF up to 2560px and 3 MB; an animated GIF or WebP moves while it is shown. It covers the area (centred, cropped), so give it some alpha to let the colour through.

knobs.title: Panel picture
knobs.description: A picture over the background of the volume panel, cut to its rounded corners. PNG, WebP, JPG or GIF up to 2560px and 3 MB; an animated GIF or WebP moves while it is shown. It covers the area (centred, cropped), so give it some alpha to let the colour through.

knobs.title: Brightness bar fill picture
knobs.description: A picture in the filled part of the brightness bar, instead of its colour. PNG, WebP, JPG or GIF up to 2560px and 3 MB; an animated GIF or WebP moves. It covers the slider (centred, cropped) and stays where it is: the fill uncovers it as the value grows.

knobs.title: Volume slider fill picture
knobs.description: A picture in the filled part of the volume sliders (the panel and the quick settings volume slider), instead of their colour. PNG, WebP, JPG or GIF up to 2560px and 3 MB; an animated GIF or WebP moves. It covers the slider (centred, cropped) and stays where it is: the fill uncovers it as the value grows.

knobs.title: Battery frame
knobs.description: The outline of the battery icon, always drawn. Setting a frame or a fill replaces the stock battery everywhere (status bar, lock screen, quick settings). A white picture with transparency: the status bar tints it like every icon. A GIF or animated WebP moves. It is drawn as large as fits the battery box, the shape kept.

knobs.title: Battery fill
knobs.description: The inside of the battery: shown from the empty side up to the charge level, over the frame. A white picture with transparency: the status bar tints it like every icon. A GIF or animated WebP moves. It is drawn as large as fits the battery box, the shape kept.

knobs.title: Charging picture
knobs.description: A picture over the battery while the phone charges (a bolt, for example). A white picture with transparency: the status bar tints it like every icon. A GIF or animated WebP moves. It is drawn as large as fits the battery box, the shape kept.

knobs.title: Battery fill direction
knobs.description: 0 fills from the left, 1 fills upwards (for a standing battery).

knobs.title: Standard curve
knobs.description: The most used curve of the system: apps opening, sheets, most movement. It starts quick and settles slowly. It is SVG path data from 0,0 to 1,1 (x is the time, y the progress): 'M 0,0 C 0.4,0 0.2,1 1,1' is one curve with two handles. A value that is not such a curve is refused. Try 'M 0,0 C 0.3,1.4 0.5,1 1,1' for a bounce.

knobs.title: Emphasized curve
knobs.description: A strong curve with a quick start and a long calm end, used for the big movements like opening an app from the launcher. It is SVG path data from 0,0 to 1,1 (x is the time, y the progress): 'M 0,0 C 0.4,0 0.2,1 1,1' is one curve with two handles. A value that is not such a curve is refused. Try 'M 0,0 C 0.3,1.4 0.5,1 1,1' for a bounce.

knobs.title: Emphasized curve (long)
knobs.description: The same shape as the emphasized curve, used by the activity and wallpaper transitions. It is SVG path data from 0,0 to 1,1 (x is the time, y the progress): 'M 0,0 C 0.4,0 0.2,1 1,1' is one curve with two handles. A value that is not such a curve is refused. Try 'M 0,0 C 0.3,1.4 0.5,1 1,1' for a bounce.

knobs.title: Emphasized decelerate
knobs.description: Things that come on to the screen. It is SVG path data from 0,0 to 1,1 (x is the time, y the progress): 'M 0,0 C 0.4,0 0.2,1 1,1' is one curve with two handles. A value that is not such a curve is refused. Try 'M 0,0 C 0.3,1.4 0.5,1 1,1' for a bounce.

knobs.title: Emphasized accelerate
knobs.description: Things that leave the screen. It is SVG path data from 0,0 to 1,1 (x is the time, y the progress): 'M 0,0 C 0.4,0 0.2,1 1,1' is one curve with two handles. A value that is not such a curve is refused. Try 'M 0,0 C 0.3,1.4 0.5,1 1,1' for a bounce.

knobs.title: Standard (Material)
knobs.description: Movement of things that stay on the screen. It is SVG path data from 0,0 to 1,1 (x is the time, y the progress): 'M 0,0 C 0.4,0 0.2,1 1,1' is one curve with two handles. A value that is not such a curve is refused. Try 'M 0,0 C 0.3,1.4 0.5,1 1,1' for a bounce.

knobs.title: Standard decelerate
knobs.description: Small things that appear. It is SVG path data from 0,0 to 1,1 (x is the time, y the progress): 'M 0,0 C 0.4,0 0.2,1 1,1' is one curve with two handles. A value that is not such a curve is refused. Try 'M 0,0 C 0.3,1.4 0.5,1 1,1' for a bounce.

knobs.title: Standard accelerate
knobs.description: Small things that disappear. It is SVG path data from 0,0 to 1,1 (x is the time, y the progress): 'M 0,0 C 0.4,0 0.2,1 1,1' is one curve with two handles. A value that is not such a curve is refused. Try 'M 0,0 C 0.3,1.4 0.5,1 1,1' for a bounce.

knobs.title: Decelerate curve
knobs.description: Fades and things that enter: a straight start and a slow end. It is SVG path data from 0,0 to 1,1 (x is the time, y the progress): 'M 0,0 C 0.4,0 0.2,1 1,1' is one curve with two handles. A value that is not such a curve is refused. Try 'M 0,0 C 0.3,1.4 0.5,1 1,1' for a bounce.

knobs.title: Accelerate curve
knobs.description: Fades and things that leave: a quick start and a straight end. It is SVG path data from 0,0 to 1,1 (x is the time, y the progress): 'M 0,0 C 0.4,0 0.2,1 1,1' is one curve with two handles. A value that is not such a curve is refused. Try 'M 0,0 C 0.3,1.4 0.5,1 1,1' for a bounce.

knobs.title: Short animation time
knobs.description: Milliseconds of small movements inside the system: menus, popups, the lock screen coming in. Apps open and close with the times below.

knobs.title: Medium animation time
knobs.description: Milliseconds of the normal movements of dialogs and sheets.

knobs.title: Long animation time
knobs.description: Milliseconds of the slow movements of the system.

knobs.title: App change, short
knobs.description: Milliseconds of short window effects (a popup growing).

knobs.title: App change
knobs.description: Milliseconds of dialogs and popups opening and closing.

knobs.title: How the panel comes in
knobs.description: 0 slides in from the edge (stock), 1 grows out of the edge of the screen, 2 pops up and fades in, 3 only fades in.

knobs.title: Entrance spring stiffness
knobs.description: How hard the spring that moves the panel pulls. Stock 700; higher is faster and snappier (50 to 5000).

knobs.title: Entrance spring damping
knobs.description: How quickly the swing of the spring dies out. Stock 0.9; lower swings more and wobbles, 1 stops without overshoot (0.2 to 1.5).

knobs.title: Show all sliders
knobs.description: Shows the sliders of ring, notification, alarm, call and system beside the media one, not only the ones that are playing.

knobs.title: Shortcut width
knobs.description: Width of the round buttons at the bottom corners of the lock screen.

knobs.title: Shortcut height
knobs.description: Height of those buttons. With a different width and a rounding below half of it they are not circles any more.

knobs.title: Shortcut rounding
knobs.description: Corner radius of those buttons: 24dp makes a circle of the stock size, 12dp a rounded square.

knobs.title: Shortcut symbol padding
knobs.description: Space between the edge of the button and its symbol; more padding makes the symbol smaller.

knobs.title: Shortcut distance from the side
knobs.description: How far the buttons sit from the left and right edge of the screen.

knobs.title: Shortcut distance from the bottom
knobs.description: How far the buttons sit above the bottom edge of the screen.

knobs.title: Shortcut colour, on
knobs.description: The filled button of a shortcut that is on (the flashlight lit). Fully transparent keeps the colour of the theme.

knobs.title: Shortcut symbol colour, on
knobs.description: The symbol of a shortcut that is on. Fully transparent keeps the colour of the theme.

knobs.title: Shortcut colour, off
knobs.description: The filled button of a shortcut that is off. Fully transparent keeps the colour of the theme.

knobs.title: Shortcut symbol colour, off
knobs.description: The symbol of a shortcut that is off. Fully transparent keeps the colour of the theme.

knobs.title: Camera shortcut symbol
knobs.description: The symbol of this lock screen shortcut (also in the list where shortcuts are chosen). A PNG with transparency, any size: it is scaled to 24dp high and tinted, so draw a simple white shape.

knobs.title: Video camera shortcut symbol
knobs.description: The symbol of this lock screen shortcut (also in the list where shortcuts are chosen). A PNG with transparency, any size: it is scaled to 24dp high and tinted, so draw a simple white shape.

knobs.title: Wallet shortcut symbol
knobs.description: The symbol of this lock screen shortcut (also in the list where shortcuts are chosen). A PNG with transparency, any size: it is scaled to 24dp high and tinted, so draw a simple white shape.

knobs.title: QR scanner shortcut symbol
knobs.description: The symbol of this lock screen shortcut (also in the list where shortcuts are chosen). A PNG with transparency, any size: it is scaled to 24dp high and tinted, so draw a simple white shape.

knobs.title: Assistant shortcut symbol
knobs.description: The symbol of this lock screen shortcut (also in the list where shortcuts are chosen). A PNG with transparency, any size: it is scaled to 24dp high and tinted, so draw a simple white shape.

knobs.title: Mute shortcut symbol
knobs.description: The symbol of this lock screen shortcut (also in the list where shortcuts are chosen). A PNG with transparency, any size: it is scaled to 24dp high and tinted, so draw a simple white shape.

knobs.title: Do not disturb shortcut symbol
knobs.description: The symbol of this lock screen shortcut (also in the list where shortcuts are chosen). A PNG with transparency, any size: it is scaled to 24dp high and tinted, so draw a simple white shape.

knobs.title: Tile sizes
knobs.description: Gives tiles a size of their own, like 'internet:2x1,flashlight:1x2,dnd:2x2': the name of the tile, a colon, the columns it covers, an x and the rows it covers (1 to 3). A tile of one column shows only its symbol, wider ones also the label, and a tile that covers several rows is centred in all of them. Join tiles with a plus to put several in one cell, like 'dnd+flashlight:2x2': in a tall cell they sit one above the other, in a one row cell side by side. The tiles keep their order and each cell goes to the first free place from the top left, so a tall tile leaves a gap beside it that the next small tiles fill. Names are the same as for the tile pictures: internet, bt, cell, airplane, flashlight, nfc, cast, hotspot, location, rotation, dnd, battery, saver, inversion, night. A tile that is not named keeps its size. Empty keeps the stock grid. Only the panel itself changes: the edit screen still shows the stock grid.

knobs.title: Screen change time
knobs.description: Milliseconds of the movement when one screen of an app opens or closes over another (the swipe of a back gesture too).

knobs.title: App change time
knobs.description: Milliseconds of the movement between two apps, when an app starts another one.

knobs.title: Split opening time
knobs.description: Milliseconds of a screen opening beside another in a split layout.

knobs.title: Split closing time
knobs.description: Milliseconds of a screen of a split layout closing.

knobs.title: Unlock animation length
knobs.description: How long the screen behind the lock screen takes to arrive after unlocking, in milliseconds. 0 keeps the stock 300 (100 to 1500).

knobs.title: Unlock: start size
knobs.description: How big the screen behind is when unlocking starts, 1 is full size. Stock 0.95; 1.3 starts big and shrinks into place, 0.5 grows from half (0.3 to 2).

knobs.title: Unlock: start height offset
knobs.description: Where the screen behind starts, as a part of the screen height below its place (negative starts above). Stock 0.05 (-1 to 1).

knobs.title: Unlock: start side offset
knobs.description: Where the screen behind starts, as a part of the screen width to the right of its place (negative starts at the left). Stock 0 (-1 to 1).

knobs.title: Unlock: start turn
knobs.description: How far the screen behind is turned when unlocking starts, in degrees; it turns back to 0 while arriving. Stock 0 (-90 to 90).

knobs.title: Unlock: turning point height
knobs.description: The height the screen behind grows and turns around, as a part of the screen height from the top. Stock 0.66 (0 to 1).

knobs.title: Clock size, open
knobs.description: The size of the big clock above the quick settings when they are open (stock 36sp). The small clock in the top bar keeps its size. 0 keeps the stock size (14sp to 90sp).

knobs.title: Clock colour
knobs.description: The colour of the clock above the quick settings. Fully transparent keeps the theme's colour.

knobs.title: Clock: move sideways
knobs.description: Moves the clock to the right (negative: to the left), in dp.

knobs.title: Clock: move down
knobs.description: Moves the clock down (negative: up), in dp.

knobs.title: Clock: single digits
knobs.description: One entry for every digit from the left (hour tens, hour ones, minute tens, minute ones), separated by commas. An entry is scale/colour/lift and any part may be empty: 1.3/#FF5CC8/-4,1/#FFFFFF/0,, makes the first digit bigger, pink and 4dp lower and the second white.

knobs.title: Date size
knobs.description: The size of the date above the quick settings. 0 keeps the size of the theme (10sp to 40sp).

knobs.title: Date colour
knobs.description: The colour of the date above the quick settings. Fully transparent keeps the theme's colour.

knobs.title: Date: move sideways
knobs.description: Moves the date to the right (negative: to the left), in dp.

knobs.title: Date: move down
knobs.description: Moves the date down (negative: up), in dp.

knobs.title: Switch track, on
knobs.description: The track of a switch in Settings that is on. Fully transparent keeps the theme's colour.

knobs.title: Switch track, off
knobs.description: The track of a switch in Settings that is off.

knobs.title: Switch knob, on
knobs.description: The round knob of a switch that is on.

knobs.title: Switch knob, off
knobs.description: The round knob of a switch that is off.

knobs.title: Switch track picture
knobs.description: A picture for the track of a switch that is on; a moving WebP or GIF moves.

knobs.title: Slider, filled part
knobs.description: The filled part and the knob of the sliders in Settings.

knobs.title: Slider, empty part
knobs.description: The empty part of the sliders in Settings.

knobs.title: Slider fill picture
knobs.description: A picture for the filled part of the sliders, bar-shaped and round; it may move (on the round ones it is as wide as the track and cut off at the knob).

knobs.title: Screen on animation
knobs.description: How the lock screen arrives when the screen turns on: 0 stock, 1 starts big and settles, 2 starts small and grows, 3 rises from below, 4 falls in with a bounce, 5 turns in, 6 flips like a card.

knobs.title: Screen on animation length
knobs.description: How long it takes, in milliseconds (80 to 2000).

knobs.title: Sheet colour
knobs.description: The colour of the bottom sheets (the expanded volume panel and others). A see-through colour lets the blur behind show. Fully transparent keeps the theme.

knobs.title: Sheet picture
knobs.description: A picture behind the content of the sheets; a moving WebP or GIF moves.

knobs.title: Sheet corner radius
knobs.description: The rounding of the top corners in dp. -1 keeps the theme (0 to 60).

knobs.title: Sheet blur
knobs.description: How much the sheets blur what is behind them, in dp. 0 is none, -1 keeps the theme (0 to 120).

knobs.title: Sheet frost
knobs.description: A milky veil over the sheet, 0 to 100.

knobs.title: Sheet shine
knobs.description: Light on the top edge of the sheet, 0 to 100.

knobs.title: Sheet gloss
knobs.description: A bright diagonal band across the sheet like a reflection, 0 to 100.

knobs.title: Sheet rim light
knobs.description: A bright edge round the sheet, stronger at the top left, 0 to 100.

knobs.title: Switch knob picture, on
knobs.description: A picture in the knob of a switch that is on, in place of the check mark. A moving WebP or GIF moves. Keep it simple: it is small (about 16dp).

knobs.title: Switch knob picture, off
knobs.description: A picture in the knob of a switch that is off, in place of the cross.

knobs.title: Switch knob without picture
knobs.description: True removes the check mark and the cross.

knobs.title: Switch toggle animation
knobs.description: How a switch moves when you turn it: 0 not, 1 pop, 2 spin, 3 jelly, 4 drop from above with a bounce.

knobs.title: Switch turning time
knobs.description: How long a picture-strip switch and the toggle animation take, in milliseconds (0 is the speed of the stock switch, about 250; 700 shows every picture of a longer strip).

knobs.title: Switch picture strip
knobs.description: One picture for the whole switch, track and knob together: a strip of frames side by side, from off (left) to on (right). The switch plays it forward when it is turned on and backward when it is turned off, so a moon can become a sun. The height of the strip is the height of the switch (about 32dp at 3 times: 96 px), up to 2560 px wide.

knobs.title: Switch picture strip: frames
knobs.description: How many frames the strip has (2 to 60).

knobs.title: Clock: growth when open
knobs.description: How much bigger the clock gets when the quick settings are open, compared with the small clock of the top bar (stock 2.57). Only used when the clock size above is 0 (1 to 4).

knobs.title: Opening window colour
knobs.description: The window an app shows while it starts from nothing (a cold start; an app that is still in memory just animates). With an alpha below full the screen behind shows through it, so a see-through opening window is one colour with some alpha. No colour keeps the colour each app asks for. Apps that bring their own splash screen are painted over as well.

knobs.title: Opening window picture
knobs.description: A picture over the whole opening window, on top of its colour, centred and cropped. PNG, WebP, JPG or GIF; an animated GIF or WebP moves while the app starts. Give it some alpha to see the colour and the screen behind through it. Only shown on cold starts.

knobs.title: Picture instead of the app icon
knobs.description: A picture in the middle of the opening window in place of the app's icon, as big as the icon size below. An animated GIF or WebP moves while the app starts, so one GIF gives every app the same loading animation. Keep it short: the window only stays until the app has drawn its first frame.

knobs.title: Strength of the icon
knobs.description: How much of the app icon (or of the picture in its place) shows in the opening window, in percent. 0 hides it, which leaves only the colour and the background picture.

knobs.title: Icon size in the opening window
knobs.description: How big the app icon (or the picture in its place) is in the middle of the opening window.

knobs.title: Least time the opening window stays
knobs.description: Counted from the start of the app, in milliseconds. The window normally goes the moment the app has drawn its first frame, which can be too quick to see a long animation. 0 keeps that; 1500 keeps it for at least one and a half seconds. The app is ready underneath, only the reveal waits. At most 5000.

knobs.title: How the opening window leaves
knobs.description: The way the window an app opens in (the splash screen of a cold start) goes away when the app is shown. This is not the animation of an app closing.

choices.0: Circle opens and the window slides up

knobs.title: Opening window: length of leaving
knobs.description: How long the window takes to go away, in milliseconds.

knobs.title: Opening window: wait before leaving
knobs.description: A pause between the icon starting to fade and the app showing, in milliseconds.

knobs.title: Opening window: icon fading out
knobs.description: How long the icon (or the picture in its place) takes to fade away, in milliseconds.
